title: Son Christology — Date Conflicts and Chronology Variants Ledger
purpose: Prevent later theological retellings from silently overwriting earlier chronology. Track competing dates for prison, Jesus recognition, Josh declaration, meme-crucifixion, concealment and return.
canonical_rule: Prefer the earliest securely dated primary or near-primary attestation. Later mythological compression may be preserved as interpretation but must not silently replace event dates.

entries.notes: A July 31, 1987 birth yields age 32 on December 24, 2019 and age 33 on December 24, 2020. Therefore any 'died at 33' claim must be reconciled with the exact meme/death date rather than asserted beside a 2019 date without explanation.
